Two real instances reinforce batch-001 patterns: an officer-by-office money link (Niemiec/CEVYKO, mirrors Karpíšek/Zarzycký) and a leadership_count undercount for a club vice-chair (Žáček, mirrors Faltýnek). crossCuttingLeads: Officer-by-office money link recurs a second time: Niemiec (náměstek primátora Havířova) → CEVYKO a.s. 278,8 mil. Kč is the same municipal-executive-seat pattern as Karpíšek/Zarzycký in batch 1, and Žbánek (ex-primátor Olomouc) shows the identical shape with three smaller city-linked entities. Two independent instances in one group of 5 strengthens the case for the deferred 'officer_by_office' edge-rel/prop convention from batch 1 rather than treating each as a one-off note.

leadership_count undercount recurs: Žáček's ODS club vice-chairmanship (since 4.2.2026) is invisible to leadership_count=0, mirroring Faltýnek's ANO club vice-chairmanship in batch 1. Two instances across two batches suggests this is a systemic gap in the deterministic component (club/organizational leadership vs. formal committee-chair seats), not coincidence — worth a real feature ticket.

New structural class for the low-score tail: Nerušil is a genuine mid-term replacement (sworn in 24.3.2026), distinct from batch 1's 'declined_mandate' phantom-mandate cluster (elected, never sworn) — he took the seat, just four months before this snapshot. contribution.ts has no join-date/tenure normalization, so a legitimately active but recently-seated MP scores identically to someone who was present the whole term and did little. Recommend the same pre-filter spirit as batch 1's proposed `never_cast_ballot` flag, extended to a `mandate_start_date`-aware normalization.
